query: For an elemental Cr coating on a zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate, what single intervention could prevent premature coating failure caused by elevated-temperature Cr–Zr interdiffusion while preserving protection under both normal subcritical-water operation and accident-relevant high-temperature steam? Formulate one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains the mechanism, predicts performance relative to the unmodified Cr-coated baseline, defines the relevant temperature, exposure-time, and environmental boundaries, cites supporting prior evidence, and specifies a discriminating experiment and outcome that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The deposition of an aluminum oxide (Al2O3) interlayer between the Cr coating and the zirconium-alloy substrate will prevent premature coating failure caused by Cr-Zr interdiffusion, while preserving protection under both normal subcritical-water operation and accident-relevant high-temperature steam.
generation.material_initial_state: Elemental Cr coating on a zirconium-alloy fuel-cladding substrate
generation.intervention: Aluminum oxide (Al2O3) interlayer deposition between the Cr coating and the zirconium-alloy substrate
generation.conditions: Elevated temperatures up to 1200°C, subcritical water, and high-temperature steam environments
generation.mechanism: The Al2O3 interlayer acts as a diffusion barrier, preventing Cr-Zr interdiffusion and reducing the formation of brittle intermetallic compounds, thus preserving the protective Cr coating
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved coating durability and protection under both normal and accident-relevant conditions, with a predicted 2-3 fold increase in coating lifespan
generation.boundary: Temperature: up to 1200°C, exposure time: dependent on operating conditions, environment: subcritical water and high-temperature steam
generation.uncertainty: The actual increase in coating lifespan may vary depending on the specific operating conditions and the quality of the Al2O3 interlayer

falsification_experiment.design: Accelerated testing of Cr-coated zirconium-alloy substrates with and without Al2O3 interlayer under simulated operating conditions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the Al2O3 interlayer does not significantly reduce the formation of brittle intermetallic compounds and improve coating lifespan, the hypothesis is falsified
